name: Suzumori Shizuna
source: Became guardian of Yuuya after his parents death. Is very kind and trustworthy, but is also terrible frightful, and is an absolute authority in Yuuya's household. Owner of the café Kaguraya, in which also Yuuya, and later Aya and Solne, work. Her power is "Kyokou" (hollow happiness).
